description: Authenticates through a browser and obtains an OAuth 2.0 authorization code for credential exchange, as part of the AWS sign-in (AWS login) flow.

researchLinks.description: AWS Login Phishing Attack: How Attackers Exploit New Authentication
Phishing for AWS credentials via the new AWS login flow

securityImplications: Attackers might use AuthorizeOAuth2Access to phish a victim through the legitimate AWS unified login cross-device flow (client_id arn:aws:signin:::devtools/cross-device), getting the victim to authorize the attacker's session and hand over access to their AWS account.
